reports.desc: I was researching weighted vests and found Ryken online. I ordered one on August 23, 2026, paying for it with a credit card. I received an email that same day stating that my order was reserved for their next inventory release. I also received an email stating that the order was being prepared for shipping. When I check that email there are two buttons: one to view the order and one to track the order with Shop. The links worked initially, but do not work now. When I go to the original Ryken website I used, it does not work. I've sent 3 emails asking for clarification and have not received any response.

I contacted the merchant on 9-16-26 after not receiving my merchandise. They indicated that based on their tracking information my items were delivered on 9-16-26. However, I never received any items. I requested a refund and for over two weeks the only response I been given is that they are conducting an investigation with the logistics company.
Popular product. other suppliers. Misrepresented. Never received. Tracking and email provided don't work

This is for a mp3 portable player. The shipped once, delivered to wrong city, sent another, still delivered to wrong city. Now no response to emails or instant messaging. I now believe they have changed their name to something else. I have heard this is a scam called “dropped shipping”.
They come at you with a job offer that you can do on your own, promoting other businesses items.  But eventually you get package deals, upload more money than you have and keep getting negative.
This website is copying listings for our store's inventory and attempting to sell items that they don't have.<br class="t-last-br" />

I placed an order once for face pads from a social media ad. I was emailed about a month later that my credit card was going to be charged again and I was enrolled in a subscription. There was no information regarding a subscription in my order or my confirmtion when I placed the order. I emailed customer service that I did not want this subscription, nor did I sign up for anything. I told them to cancel my order. My credit card was charged again. When I got the email confirmation of the second charge, I emailed them again and this time my emails were replied to by AI just going in circles with the same questions.
The face pads completely fall apart when I try to pull them out of the container. I don't even use them. I certainly don't want more. This company is a nightmare.

reports.desc: An individual from Berry Supply LLC (in my situation "Glen Ishan" or "Glen Ishaan") will reach out to you asking to book with your business for teambuilding, etc. for their employees. Then, they'll ask if you accept credit card and if you will help them make the payout to their professional photographer who will also be coming to the event. They may pay you in full: your services, the photographer's fees, any extra fees you bill them. Then, they will cc you with some bogus photographer email and tell you the photographer must take a direct bank transfer. I'm sure they take all your money if you follow through with all of this. But we're going to get them before they can.
They Said I was getting paid and I never received Pay

I first saw a video on fb about this native American lady who was selling handcrafted bags and i wanted one so i looked up her website and ordered the bag i wanted plus a mystery box and insurance. The total came out to $72.63. When i went back to check the status of my order on her website, it came up as an error saying this business does not exsist. And i saw a post on fb from someone who said her granddaughter had looked it up and it came out to be a scam. Others have complained that the product they received is fake and not what the site is advertising. I have attempted to contact the seller but have not received any response back about this issue.
Trying to say I was pre approved for a loan.
These people repeatedly keep calling, leaving messages regarding my past-due taxes. I don't have past-due taxes and haven't answered any of the calls.

They said I was approved for $5500.00 loan, but after filling in all the info they then said I was approved and all I had to do was make the first-time payment of 80.58 first loan payment,  didn't pay. But they have personal info. I'm elderly and needed ths for a deposit on a home.
